findings.F4_edge_positivity_all_spectra: Etilde_e>=0 for EVERY positive spectrum. The (a,b) block has determinant r^2(1-x_i-x_j)/(x_i x_j)>0; Schur complement in s equals (d_i d_j/4)[4-p(1/d_k+1/d_l)] with p=x_i+x_j, using 4g_e=p(d_i+d_j)+4d_i d_j and 1/r=Sum 1/d; and p(1/d_k+1/d_l)=(1-x_l/d_k)+(1-x_k/d_l)<2, so the Schur margin exceeds d_i d_j/2.
findings.F5_reduction: G7 (hence E_full>=0 via K_full>=K_c) is EQUIVALENT to Lemma N: Sum_e Etilde_e+Sum_i (d_i^2 x_i/2)Sum_j x_j|rho_ij-Delta_ij|^2 >= Sum_i (r-d_i x_i/2) var_i(T) for all T,sigma.
